english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately changing something’s appearance, condition, nature, or function.
Use this when shifting an approach, form, character, or other nonphysical aspect.

examples.english: This design can transform the feel of the whole house.
examples.traditional: 呢個設計可以改變成間屋嘅感覺。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3 sing4 gaan1 uk1 ge3 gam2 gok3

examples.english: We need to shift our strategy to catch up with our opponent.
examples.traditional: 我哋要改變策略，先可以追到對手。
